item.title: Desktop releases are now available
item.description:
TopWaatch for desktop is here — native apps for Linux and Windows are ready to download.
Take your watchlist, progress, and TopWaatch Cinema with you outside the browser. Pick the build that fits your system on our download page: AppImage, .deb, .rpm, or Windows setup (.exe or .msi).
Already using the desktop app? Updates roll out automatically when new releases ship.
Head to the Download page to get the latest build for your platform.

item.title: Welcome to TopWaatch!
item.description:
We're glad you're here welcome to the TopWaatch community.
TopWaatch helps you discover movies and TV shows, pick up where you left off, and keep track of what you love. We don't host any videos ourselves. When you hit play, TopWaatch searches third-party sources on the internet and brings the stream to you in one place.
What we're building toward: a streaming experience that feels personal, reliable, and built with our community in mind not just another clone, but a home for people who care about how they watch.
We're early (v0.1.0), and there's a lot ahead. Your feedback and patience as we grow mean everything.
Thanks for being here. Happy watching!
